decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out the numerous accessory items such as charging cables, power adapters, and protective cases that were mixed into the feed. From the remaining actual speakers, I prioritized brands with high ratings and established reputations for sound quality. The consideration set includes two JBL models, a Bose, a Harman Kardon, and a high-power budget option (BOGASING). I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 5 because it has an exceptional 4.8 rating from over 16,000 reviews and features an integrated power bank (charge out), which is highly practical for outdoor use, justifyng the $149.95 price tag over the smaller Flip 5.
